reviewNotes: Reviewed every exported key against data/adverbs.json source furigana and vocabulary readings. Sentence prompts and explanations use 1.0; standalone adverbs and short choice groups use 0.85. Contextual は -> わ reviewed by exact key/occurrence, preserving はんだん, はっきり, はなしません, はち, あてはまる, ごはん, はちじはん, はっしゃ, はかり/はかります, はじめる, はる, なのはな and はっこう. Directional 映画館へ and 駅へ -> え; lexical へいじつ/へや preserved. Object を -> お. Residual kanji converted using the source vocabulary furigana, preserving long vowels/small kana in katakana. Corrected source 三十人(じゅうにん) to さんじゅうにん. Contextual 入れない (cannot enter the room) uses はいれない; topic 普段は -> ふだんわ. Exported 菜のなのはな corrected to なのはな matching 菜の花(なのはな). Added fragment punctuation. Display labels/lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
